document.title: Act
document.description: The record card for one act — billing such as headliner or support, genre, expected draw, and the stage and time of their set; open it when a performer, band, DJ or the headliner is the subject.

actId.description: The act whose set this concerns.

document.title: Agent
document.description: The answer to the sentence on the line, as a briefing: the question, the answer in sentences that each cite a card on screen, what was read to give it, the steps of a plan as chips, and up to three follow-up sentences.

document.title: Earlier
document.description: The turns of this shift so far, one line each, newest first: what the operator said and what either the cards or the agent made of it. Click one to read it in full.

document.title: On site
document.description: How many people are on site right now — total attendance against the capacity of the whole site, with how full each zone is; open it when someone asks how many guests, people, attendees or visitors there are, how busy it is, or how full the festival is.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

document.title: Watching
document.description: What the room has noticed without being asked: how many events were triaged and how many raised, the one line the agent wrote about a critical one, how many raised cards are folded away, and whether the ceiling on event passes has bitten.

document.title: Crowd
document.description: A gauge of how full one zone is — headcount against capacity at one hour; open it when crowding, capacity, density or whether people will fit somewhere is mentioned.

zoneId.description: The zone of the site this is about.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

document.title: Director
document.description: Plays Saturday evening as a feed of real writes: play, pause and speed, with the festival clock.

document.title: Incidents
document.description: The feed of open incidents, newest first — medical, security, technical, crowd and weather reports, each with where it is; open it when incidents, problems, injuries, faults or what has gone wrong is mentioned.

document.title: Intent
document.description: The line the operator types what is happening into; the room assembles itself around it.

props.placeholder: say what is happening — “storm at 9 move headliner to the tent”

document.title: Maybe
document.description: Cards the model is unsure about, offered as chips the operator can promote with a click.

data.idle: Nothing needs attention right now. Say what is happening.

document.title: X-ray
document.description: How the room decided: the story of the last pass — what was typed, what the fast model decided, what the assistant was handed and said, what was refused and why, what changed on screen — then timings and cost, and the demo controls.

props.value: No pass yet — nothing has been measured.
A scripted Saturday evening, written to the database by a separate principal — the room sees it the way it would see the real site.
Heard nothing it could name: no time, no row.
How much it wanted each card on screen:
Nothing has been typed yet. The story of a sentence appears here as soon as there is one.

document.title: Running order
document.description: The running order — every stage and its sets across one day on an hour axis, with one act lit and every set exposed to bad weather lit up; open it when an act, the headliner, a clash, a changeover or a set time is mentioned, or when a storm, rain or wind threatens the programme.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

stageId.description: Show only the sets on this one stage; leave unset for every stage.

highlightActId.description: The act whose set is lit on the running order.

document.title: Impact of the move
document.description: What a relocation would cost, line by line with a verdict: whether the expected crowd fits the target, what it clashes with on that stage, the changeover gap, and whether that stage has a roof against the weather at that hour.

props.value: Pick an act and a stage to see what the move would do.

actId.description: The act whose set this concerns.

toStageId.description: The stage the act is moving to.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

document.title: Push to attendees
document.description: The form that drafts a push notification to attendees or crew — pick the audience and how urgent it is; open it when the operator wants to warn, tell, alert or notify people of something.

props.title: Push
props.subtitle: draft — nothing is sent until you send it

audience.description: Who receives it: everyone on site, people in the main arena, people at the tent, the campsite, the vendors, or the crew.

urgency.description: How urgent the message is, which sets how loudly a phone announces it.

body.description: The text of the message, as attendees will read it on their phones: one or two plain sentences, what is happening and what to do.

document.title: Sales
document.description: A chart of ticket or bar sales — units or revenue, by hour or by day, for one day or the whole weekend, optionally against the day before; open it when money, takings, revenue, tickets sold or the bars are mentioned.

metric.description: What the bars measure: revenue is money taken, units is how many were sold.

grain.description: The width of one bar: an hour of trading, or a whole festival day.

range.description: How much to chart: today alone, or the whole weekend so far.

compare.description: Compare against the day before, drawn behind the bars.

kind.description: Which takings: tickets sold at the gates, or drinks sold at the bar.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

document.title: Delay a set
document.description: The form that delays the set of one act by a number of minutes — a hold on the running order; open it when the operator wants to delay, hold, postpone or push back an act.

actId.description: The act whose set this concerns.

minutes.description: How many minutes to hold the set for, 0–120.

document.title: Site map
document.description: The site map — every zone as a region coloured by how full it is, with one zone outlined; open it when a place, zone, field, gate or crowd movement is mentioned.

focusZoneId.description: The zone of the site this is about.

overlay.description: What colours the zones: crowd fills them by headcount over capacity; plain draws the plan alone.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

document.title: Right now
document.description: What is going on across the whole site right now — who is on stage and who is up next, bad weather due in the next three hours, open incidents, holds called on sets and the fullest zones; open it when someone asks what is going on, what is happening, or for a status or an overview.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

document.title: Move a set
document.description: The form that moves the set of one act to another stage or start time — a slot swap on the running order; open it when the operator wants to move, swap, relocate or reschedule an act.

props.value: The running order refused that move.

actId.description: The act whose set this concerns.

fromStageId.description: The stage the act is moving from.

toStageId.description: The stage the act is moving to.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

document.title: Stage
document.description: One stage in detail — whether it is covered or open-air, its capacity, and the sets on it that day; open it when a particular stage is the subject.

props.empty: Nothing on this stage that day.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.

document.title: Weather
document.description: The weather radar aimed at one hour — rain, wind and storm cells across the day, with the asked-about hour marked; open it when weather, rain, wind, lightning or a storm is mentioned.

day.description: Festival day: fri, sat or sun.
